title: Moonshine: Free On-Device Speech-to-Text, TTS & Intent Recognition
description:
Moonshine is a free, open-source toolkit for real-time voice interfaces. It runs speech-to-text, intent recognition, and text-to-speech entirely on your device – no cloud, no API keys, no credit card. It's a fast alternative to Whisper with millisecond latency. Install with one pip command. Works on iOS, Android, Raspberry Pi, and more.
